criteria.rationale: Factual correctness -- pip installs into an existing active environment and creates nothing; venv creates environments and is stdlib; virtualenv is venv's older third-party predecessor; pipx installs CLI apps each into their own isolated env while exposing the command globally; uv is a single fast Rust-based tool replacing several of the others -- verified via source_inspection: matches each tool's own documented purpose and scope exactly, with no conflation between 'installs packages' and 'creates environments'; uv is 10-100x faster than pip on typical operations -- verified via official_reference: consistent with uv's own published performance claims (docs.astral.sh/uv), correctly attributed rather than presented as this course's own benchmark
